discovery.common_non_scv_eligibility_gate: Phase 13C _eligible_pool gate; no changes to its metric definitions

arms.B2_MEMORY_SKILL_STORE: stores raw trace episodes as executable memory; no invariant discovery, SCV, capability formation, or composition
arms.B3_RANDOM_SKILL_CREATION: randomly creates 75% of the commonly qualified pool, sampled without replacement by a seed-keyed RNG; no SCV selection
arms.B4_COMPRESSION_PROXY: compresses repeated observed operation subsequences; not canonical DreamCoder
arms.A1_NO_IDT: consolidates only exact full trace sequences repeated at least three times; no invariant representation
arms.A1_1_FREQUENCY_ONLY: selects top-k common qualified invariants by observed frequency only, with k matched to ASFT births
arms.A2_NO_SCV: creates every member of the common eligible pool
arms.A2_1_RANDOM_SCV: randomly selects k members from the common eligible pool, where k equals ASFT selected count for that seed
arms.A2_2_NO_LIFECYCLE: disables skill lifecycle advancement while retaining ASFT candidate selection, skill storage, reuse, capability formation, and composition
arms.A3_NO_CAPABILITY_LAYER: skills and reuse remain; no capability objects or capability-derived C_t
arms.A3_1_NO_GROWTH_TRACKING: ASFT behavior is identical; all growth tracking outputs are masked as unavailable
arms.A3_2_INDEPENDENT_CAPABILITIES: forms valid capabilities but reports only individual capability outcomes; no portfolio aggregate C_t/CGM
arms.X1_NO_TRANSFER: skills remain stored but retrieval and execution of stored skills is disabled
arms.X2_NO_SKILL_LIBRARY: skills are created and counted, then discarded before evaluation; no persistent library or reuse
arms.X3_NO_EXPERIENCE_MEMORY: same one-shot discovery and skills as ASFT; discovery traces and episodic records are discarded after skill creation
arms.X4_NO_CAPABILITY_FORMATION: skills and transfer remain; capability proposal/formation is disabled while CGM instrumentation remains available

sensitivity.scv_threshold_source: Phase 13C frozen calibration q25 and q75; used here only as fixed sensitivity points, not retuned on Phase 13F outcomes

metrics.IS: mean stored invariant strength across created invariant-backed skills; raw trace baselines are not applicable
metrics.SU: mean repository Skill Utility over persistent non-provisional skills
metrics.TS: mean measured transfer score using only successful observed transfer events
metrics.CGR: repository capability growth rate from frozen Phase 13E metric pathway
metrics.IG: repository growth_metrics.compute_ig with Phase 13E frozen weights; no alternate intelligence formula
metrics.task_utility: observed success indicator minus observed reasoning cost / 100, per Phase 13E
metrics.coverage: repository capability portfolio and union of successful target families; report both

statistics.ci: two-sided Student-t across seed-level summaries, df=n-1
statistics.paired_comparisons: within-seed ASFT-minus-comparator differences on common task streams
statistics.effect_sizes: paired Cohen dz and Hedges-corrected g; report undefined when paired SD is zero
statistics.missing_outcomes: retain null/unavailable with reason; never impute

primary_decisions.ASFT_beats_each_baseline: paired 95% CI lower bound above zero for both mean task utility and mean CGR; report all metrics regardless
primary_decisions.component_matters: ASFT-minus-ablation paired 95% CI lower bound above zero on task utility or CGR, by preregistered component; report both outcomes and do not substitute
primary_decisions.sensitivity_stability: report point estimates and intervals across frozen settings; no threshold winner selection or post-hoc tolerance
